title: Bug: [Smartswitch]: NPU critical services crash when restarting DPU database service
author: prabhataravind
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

On the NPU, run `systemctl restart database@dpu0`. All ciritcal containers including swss go down due to incorrect systemd dependencies. This is probably because smartswitch used a lot of design elements from multi-asic.

```
[Unit]
Description=switch state service
Requires=database@dpu0.service

Requires=database@dpu1.service

Requires=database@dpu2.service

Requires=database@dpu3.service

Requires=database@dpu4.service

Requires=database@dpu5.service

Requires=database@dpu6.service

Requires=database@dpu7.service

After=database@dpu0.service

After=database@dpu1.service

After=database@dpu2.service

After=database@dpu3.service

After=database@dpu4.service

After=database@dpu5.service

After=database@dpu6.service

After=database@dpu7.service

Requires=config-setup.service
After=config-setup.service
BindsTo=sonic.target
After=sonic.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=1200

StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Environment="NUM_DPU=8"
Environment="IS_DPU_DEVICE=false"
User=root
Environment=sonic_asic_platform=cisco-8000
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/bin/swss.sh start
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/swss.sh wait
ExecStop=/usr/local/bin/swss.sh stop
RestartSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=sonic.target
```

Tested on Cisco smartswitch, but should be generic.

### Steps to Reproduce

```
systemctl restart database@dpu0
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected behavior: NPU services should stay up
Actual behavior: All NPU critical services including swss go down.

Description
Fixes #24892
NPU critical services crash when restarting DPU database service

#### Why I did it
NPU critical services crash when restarting DPU database service

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
Gated multi-instance dependency rewriting in systemd-sonic-generator on num_asics > 1 and updated ssg tests so SmartSwitch NPU uses database.service instead of database@dpuX.service.

#### How to verify it
On the NPU, run systemctl restart database@dpu0. All ciritcal containers including swss should not restart.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)
- [ ] 202506
- [ ] 202511

#### Tested branch (Please provide the tested image version)
202506

#### Description for the changelog
Fix SmartSwitch NPU boot dependencies by avoiding unnecessary database@dpuX.service requirements and only expanding multi-instance database units on true multi-ASIC platforms.
